characters.continuity: Chrono Series (Chrono Trigger, Chrono Cross, and related comic/manga tie-ins)
characters.summary: Crono is the silent protagonist of Chrono Trigger, wielding a katana and specializing in lightning magic and temporal manipulation. Alongside his companions, he engages in dual and triple techs, traveling across multiple time periods to defeat Lavos. He possesses immense magical prowess, including powerful area-of-effect spells and healing capabilities.

techniques: Lightning magic, including Luminaire which strikes every enemy

mechanisms: Not established by the cited source

weaknesses: vulnerable to absolute timeline destruction without proper temporal tools
Low Magic stat and poor magic defense
Was killed by Lavos in 12,000 BC and had to be revived with the Chrono Trigger
mobility: Travels through time with his party via time gates and the Epoch time machine
limitations: depends on party members for ultimate combo dual and triple techs

sources.supports: Basic gameplay abilities, lightning magic, and overarching narrative structure of Chrono Trigger.

Silent protagonist, Lightning/Heaven magic, solo techs (Cyclone, Slash, Lightning, Lightning 2, Spincut, Life, Confuse, Luminaire), dual and triple techs, death against Lavos and revival with the Time Egg
Plot: Crono killed by Lavos, revived with the Chrono Trigger; party defeats Magus, Dalton atop the Epoch, and finally destroys Lavos; time gates and the Epoch
Crono fights with a katana and Lightning magic; Luminaire hits all enemies.
Crono's only weakness is his low Magic stat and poor magic defense.

feats.claim: Defeated Lavos alongside his party at the core of time.

notableResults.note: Achieved after gathering party members across multiple eras.
